FRDP-P01-ROW10-CURSOR-PRODUCT-WORKFLOW-V1
scenario_id=frdp-p01-cursor-product-readiness-product-workflow
slice=Row10-S2
host=Cursor
mode=no-send-local-extension-runtime
task=Adapter/core submit smoke through thin Cursor adapter. steps: Identify the real local Cursor window title and process/window identity in execution notes.
Prefer an Extension Development Host or a run folder/session visibly dedicated to Row10.
If multiple monitors or overlapping windows are present, move or resize the target Cursor window so title bar and XIIGen panel area are visible before clicks.
If the target window cannot be made unambiguous, mark BLOCKED_TARGET_WINDOW_AMBIGUOUS.

signed_in_or_trusted_indicators: account menu title without private identifiers

steps: Record LOGIN_RECOVERY_REQUIRED in future UI evidence JSON.
Use Cursor's visible sign-in/account recovery control or command.
If a browser opens, capture only non-secret origin/title/window state as row10-s2-path-b-login-recovery-browser-nonsecret.png.
Pause capture while credentials, passwords, 2FA, cookies, tokens, one-time codes, or recovery codes are visible.
Allow the human/operator to complete credentials outside captured evidence.
Return to Cursor through the normal redirect/deep-link.
If signed-in/trusted state is not restored safely, mark BLOCKED_CURSOR_AUTH_NOT_RESTORED.
expected_return_state: non-secret signed-in/trusted indicator visible or safely documented

future_path_b_ui_steps.action: Open the real local Cursor target window identified in preflight.

Open the XIIGen Smart Skills extension surface/panel through a visible Activity Bar/sidebar entry, existing XIIGen panel tab, or Command Palette command whose displayed name contains XIIGen Smart Skills.
Confirm the visible panel is XIIGen Smart Skills, not generic Cursor chat, not New Agent, and not a login textbox.
Focus prompt input/textarea xiigen-smart-skills-prompt or a visible label that clearly maps to that textarea.
Paste or type the exact same Row10 prompt from this prep.
Capture the prompt-entered state before submit with prompt marker/scenario visible or safely cropped enough to prove same scenario.
Click submit/send button xiigen-smart-skills-submit or a visible button that clearly maps to that id.
Wait only for the local extension visible result/error state required by the future work order; do not use external AI, web AI, or generic Cursor chat as substitute.
Capture visible result/error state tied to the same prompt.
Write future execution evidence JSON with target, auth result, prompt hash, panel route, before/after screenshots, result/error state, and claim locks.
